import os
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from billing import MissingSecret, api_key


class BillingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_environment_secret_is_used(self):
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"PAYMENT_API_KEY": "test-only"}):
            self.assertEqual(api_key(), "test-only")

    def test_missing_secret_is_not_synthesized(self):
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
            with self.assertRaises(MissingSecret):
                api_key()
